brief:
U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee met Saturday with Palestinians in the occupied West Bank town of Turmus Ayya, including families of U.S. citizens killed by Israeli settlers, according to Al-Monitor. The visit took place amid a documented rise in violence by Jewish settlers against Palestinian communities in the territory.

Turmus Ayya has faced repeated targeting by settlers in recent months. The ambassador's direct engagement with bereaved families marks a rare high-level U.S. presence in a Palestinian community dealing with the consequences of settler attacks. The meeting coincided with broader tensions across the West Bank, where clashes between settlers and Palestinians have grown more frequent and deadly.

title: U.S. ambassador meets Palestinians bereaved by settler violence
